scope: Official documentation and saved source evidence; no live account calls or external writes
authority: Root relays owner's explicit change to direct submissions: US, then AU, CA, GB, then remaining markets

file_contract.url_response: Direct complete product file, not HTML
file_contract.actual_fetch_schedule: Must be selected and read back in Merchant; supported UI frequencies not inferred

us_row_contract.gtin_or_mpn_unknown: Omit uncertain identifier rather than invent; do not infer identifier_exists=no
us_row_contract.generative_ai_text: Known generative-AI title/description requires corresponding structured attribute; exporter should not invent new copy
us_row_contract.price_fit: Match actual purchasable variant, currency, landing page, structured data and checkout
us_row_contract.availability_fit: Active does not imply in_stock; no owned physical inventory claim
us_row_contract.incomplete_rows: Keep exact reason/count and correction queue; do not misreport independently valid subset as all products

destination_contract.other_enabled_paid_destinations: Exclude as applicable using official supported values; do not activate a paid program
destination_contract.tsv_multiple_exclusions: Comma-separated values or repeated attribute columns
destination_contract.local_inventory: Not applicable to this online-only retailer

scope: Gift cards where present and eligible

handoff.source_account_empty_before_upload: Root must confirm at action time; historical zero is insufficient
documented_sequence: Submit and verify first US file offers
Select documented Shopify Manual product sync, whose prerequisite is existing Merchant products
Read back app mode and processed source ownership before further expansion
handoff.shopify_manual_mode_effect: App no longer automatically syncs products; external file remains responsible

lifecycle.snapshot_type: Full authoritative file per source scope
lifecycle.add_update: Regenerate valid rows from current Shopify data
lifecycle.retire: Omit archived/deleted/out-of-scope items on next successful complete upload
lifecycle.google_documented_serving_removal_delay: May take 24-48 hours after Merchant removal
failure_handling_engineering_recommendat: Validate IDs, fields and row counts
Keep last complete valid file on failure
Never publish an empty or partial error result

order: Remaining supported served countries and published languages
expansion.reuse_offer_across_countries: When actual language, price/currency, landing/checkout and shipping fit
expansion.currency_conversion: Documented option; shipping currency must match submitted offer currency
expansion.unsupported_or_unknown_country_pairs: Retain prior coverage matrix distinctions; do not infer eligibility from configured Shopify countries

capacity.expansion_gate: Read actual quota/headroom and source processing results, then compare planned unique identities

next_action: Freeze and validate the US file, then obtain exact source processing and offer readback
continuation: Use the validated US file to complete the direct-publisher handoff, verify one addition/update/removal and exception assignment, then extend to AU, CA and GB using only necessary price/language contexts
